synthetic_values: Only inert synthetic canaries, including private-key markers; raw values asserted absent from public snapshot and successful shared request cache Futures. No actual credentials, secret validation tool or package-content scan.
unsupported_state_history_auxiliary_limi: SDK pagination proved only complete/second-page-denied collection envelopes; downstream partial-inventory callback semantics, repeated cursors, all unsupported states, historical revisions, lifecycle races and auxiliary identity joins outside named cases remain unproved.
